today.title: Today
today.lead: What waits on you, every day. Agents work in the background; nothing leaves your name without your say.
today.setUpTitle: First, tell the agents who you are
today.setUpBody: When agents find a job, prepare an application or draft a reply to a recruiter, it waits for you here. Start by telling them who you are and what you want next.
today.goalsTitle: Now, what do you want next?
today.goalsBody: A few short questions about the roles, places and pay you want: searches keep to them. {{answered}} of {{total}} answered.
today.searchBody: Your profile and goals are set. Search the job boards now: the good matches land in your Pipeline as Found, with why they match and their gaps.
today.matchesBody: A search found jobs that fit your profile and goals. Open them, shortlist the ones you like, and say “Not for me” to the rest.
today.nothingBody: No new matches since your last look. Another search runs tonight, or search again now.

strength.add_headline: Add a headline to your profile: it sharpens every match.
strength.add_work: Add your positions to your profile: matches are scored against them.
strength.add_skills: Add your skills to your profile: matches are scored against them.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.lead: Every opportunity agents find or you add, from first match to offer.

boards.title: Boards
boards.lead: The job boards searches read, ranked by the salaries they list, the new ones waiting for you, and what each search scanned.

agents.title: Agents
agents.lead: Each run works in its own sandbox, made for one job and deleted after.
agents.emptyBody: When a search or an application runs, you can watch what it does here as it happens: each step, the sites it reached and anything it was stopped from reaching.

profile.title: Profile & goals
profile.lead: What agents know about you. They use only what is written here, and every claim in a CV must trace back to it.
